name: Clint Eastwood (BLOCKED - real person)
sounds_like: Low-mid male at 113 Hz held inside a 4.7-semitone range - the flattest delivery measured in this library, close to level throughout. Dark (centroid 1071 Hz), dry, evenly compressed (15.5 dB range), 5.3 onsets per second with held 0.58s pauses. Elderly - the source is a 2009 BBC Radio 4 interview recorded when the speaker was 79.
avoid_for: All casting. If you need a flat, dry, laconic older male, build it from male_02 (82 Hz, dark, calm) rather than from this file.
note: BLOCKED - this is a voice clone of a real, identifiable person. This project craft notes say these must not be cast, and that holds regardless of the CC-BY 3.0 licence on the source recording: the licence covers redistributing the audio clip, not synthesising new speech in that person voice and putting words in their mouth. A card exists only so nobody rediscovers the file and casts it by accident. Do not set this to ready. Source: BBC Front Row, 31 Dec 2009, via Wikimedia Commons. Filename includes (enhanced2), so this is a processed derivative of the original CC3 clip.
